doc.name: B — editorial frames, ice rink reflections (golden hour), raw film-grain intimacy

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: ice rink reflections (golden hour)
Register: raw film-grain intimacy
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a low-angle frame of the male lead against the sky or ceiling, featuring the male lead from below.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/4, using frame-within-frame using foreground architecture, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. A hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the male lead, featuring the male lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/8, using a stacked layered composition with three depth planes, at a close-up.

LIGHT. North-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 24mm wide at f/2.8, using a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. An overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the female lead, featuring the female lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/11, using frame-within-frame using foreground architecture, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. A hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (golden hour), shot in a register of raw film-grain intimacy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a detail frame of hands, fabric or an object one lead is holding, featuring hands and wardrobe detail only.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 20mm wide at f/8, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. Paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
